spec.context: RETAKE of the reports tracker card after fixes (light). Card contract NOW: test name "Blood Sugar (Fasting)" 16px semibold; fee "₹80" 18px semibold tabular right-aligned (the decision number reads strongest) with 11px grey "Pay on collection" caption under it; caption lines; status chip "Placed — awaiting confirmation" = amber text on soft amber chip bg (#B45309 on #FFFBEB, 4.8:1); prep box = soft amber bg + 1px amber border + amber 12px text "Before the sample: Overnight fasting of 8-12 hours required". Judge: hierarchy (fee reads first-strength), chip legibility on the tinted card, prep box crispness, card rhythm, truncation, honesty of the payment caption.

defects.what: Prep text is 12px amber on soft amber — legible but the smallest body-critical text on the card; the fasting instruction is decision-relevant and deserves the card's caption size or larger for safety copy
defects.where: Prep box, 'Before the sample: Overnight fasting of 8-12 hours required'

defects.what: 'Pay on collection' caption grey reads close to the AA floor on the #F4F4F2 tinted card; estimate ~4.5:1 — passes but with no margin to spare

measured_notes: Hierarchy holds: '₹80' at ~18px semibold is visually the strongest element after the title, fee reads first-strength as contracted
Status chip: amber text on soft amber chip, estimated contrast ~4.8:1 — AA pass, chip reads as a semantic status only, not a live/teal accent — accent law respected
Prep box: soft amber bg with a visible 1px amber border, crisp; text wraps to two lines, no truncation
No ellipsis anywhere; full order ID 'cmwre9fcw0007jt08f14rzaax' and full collection slot 'Mon, 23 Nov · 07:00 - 09:00 · Pune' render untruncated
Card sits inside a ~16px screen gutter; internal spacing rhythm ~12px between title/lab/slot lines — consistent
Card radius uniform across the outer card and prep box
non_blocking_notes: 'Pay on collection' caption sits right-aligned under the fee but above the lab line — reads slightly detached from the fee it describes; nudging it directly under ₹80's baseline group would tighten grouping
Large empty canvas below the single card is fine but an empty-state affordance (e.g., 'No other reports yet') would prevent the blank area reading as a loading stall
No tap targets present on this card — nothing to measure against the 44px law on this surface
verdict.one_line: Retake passes: fee hierarchy, honest payment caption, untruncated data, and amber-only semantic status all hold; only log the 12px prep copy size and the tight caption contrast as minors.
